text: As your teen grows more independent in study, training or work, agree on a simple mental-health plan: a routine for sleep, movement and meals; people they can turn to; and what to do in an emergency. Independence means learning to care for their health, with you behind them.

review_defects.why: Arabic specifies 'your son' (ابنك) but English uses gender-neutral 'your teen'.
'سنده' means you are their support/anchor; 'behind them' is a weaker, more casual rendering.
